CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: User can select a Personal Shopper to open a client book
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Open the EIP loyalty view, use the Personal Shopper selector, and choose a shopper with assigned clients.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The selected Personal Shopper is accepted by the UI.
The client-book area loads without blocking errors.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: System lists clients assigned to the selected Personal Shopper
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: After selecting a shopper with known assignments, review the displayed client list.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Assigned clients are displayed for the selected shopper.
The list is consistent with expected ownership.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Client book shows all required detail fields
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Inspect one or more rows and confirm visibility of First Name, Last Name, Email, Preferred Language, Most Used Country, Category, % Personal Shopping, Twelve Month Return Rate, Loyalty Year Spend, Loyalty Year Pending Spend, and Current Year Net Sales.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
All required fields are visible in the client-book view.
Values render in readable business format.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: No-client scenario displays the expected message
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Select a Personal Shopper that has no assigned clients and observe the client-book panel.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The message 'There are no clients assigned' is displayed.
No misleading stale client data remains visible.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: User can switch to another Personal Shopper and view the new client book
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Change the selected shopper at least twice and compare resulting client-book contents.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Client-book content updates to match each newly selected shopper.
The previous shopper's list is not retained after the switch.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Personal Shopper sees their own client book by default
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Log in as a Personal Shopper and open the view without changing filters.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
The initial view is preloaded with the logged-in shopper's own client book.
No manual selection is required for first render.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Displayed loyalty fields stay consistent after shopper changes and page refresh
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Switch shopper, capture a few key values, refresh the page, and compare values for the same selected shopper.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Key loyalty values remain consistent for the selected shopper after refresh.
No duplicated or cross-shopper leakage appears.

CHECKLIST_ROWS.Check: Loyalty information is understandable for business users during clienteling workflows
CHECKLIST_ROWS.How to Verify: Run through a typical manager review flow and confirm the view supports quick interpretation of customer loyalty profile strength.
CHECKLIST_ROWS.Pass Criteria:
Business users can identify loyalty profile status using visible fields.
No critical label ambiguity blocks decision-making.
